translation: Clove (丁香), costus root (木香), Gua'er dragon's blood (瓜兒血竭), catechu (兒茶), cooked rhubarb (熟大黃), safflower (紅花, each one liang), Chinese angelica head (當歸頭), lotus seed (蓮肉), white poria (白茯苓), white peony (白芍, each two liang), moutan bark (丹皮, five qian), licorice (甘草, three qian). Grind all together into a fine powder, refine honey into pills, take three qian each time, taken with boy's urine (童便); yellow wine may also be used. <ins>San Yu He Shang Tang (散瘀和傷湯)</ins> Treats injuries from striking and collision, with accumulation of stagnant blood. Nux vomica (番木鱉, fried in oil and dehaired), safflower (紅花), raw pinellia (生半夏, each five qian), drynaria (骨碎補), licorice (甘草, each three qian), scallion root (蔥須, one liang). Boil in five bowls of water until rolling, add two liang of vinegar, boil for another ten-odd rolls, fumigate and wash the affected area, ten-odd times a day.
